name: @ephremyuan/citeagent

scripts.build:bin: bun build bin/install.ts --outfile=dist/bin/install.js --target=bun --format=esm && bun build bin/mcp-server.ts --outfile=dist/bin/mcp-server.js --target=bun --format=esm
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:bin
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build:all

description: OpenCode plugin for CiteAgent — AI research knowledge infrastructure with Merkle-verified retrieval and citation-indexed search
